The Chocobo Blinkers under bullet 3 are aid, not requirement: the page says 'obtain a minimum of 6' to make the escort simple, they last about an Earth minute each, and the escort can be run without them, so they stay out of items and live in the note. Bullet 2 is an outcome rather than an action, and the lead line about one Ward Warden / Desert Rain / Crimson Carpet per Vana'dielian day is a cooldown. Nothing in this quest is observable: Cruor, Resistance Credits and the Empyrean +1 leg seals are all reward, so no step carries evidence. The chocobo you escort is never named, so the 'click on the chocobo to load' half of bullet 6 has no target of its own and is folded into the trunk step. notes: Ten rungs and not one of them observable. The only thing this quest hands you is the Darksteel Sheet, which is the header's Reward and so cannot be evidence, and no key item is ever mentioned -- so every step's evidence is a deliberate null rather than a reach. The numbering goes unreliable at the end: two of the real instructions are unnumbered prose. The line sitting between bullets 9 and 10, 'You have 30 minutes to defeat the Mannequin NM named Menechme', is what actually names the fight, and the line after bullet 12, 'Once Menechme is defeated, examine the Fresh Snowmelt one last time for a cutscene and your reward', is a genuine final step; both are recorded against the nearest numbered bullets with the attribution written into the note. Bullets 10, 11 and 12 are pure tactics -- Penta Thrust, Excenmille's Stag's Cry, cure him and stay off hate -- and are not rungs. Bullet 13 is a what-if for a full inventory, a recovery path rather than a step. The Compact Footprint is examined twice, at bullets 4 and 6, with the Sunken Footprint between them, so those two cannot be merged; bullets 8 and 9 by contrast are two clicks on the Fresh Snowmelt with nothing in between, so they are one. Excenmille fights alongside you and is named, but he is never something you interact with, so he is not a target. The one-game-day wait after Blood of Heroes and the Wings of the Goddess Mission 38 requirement are both real gates and both entirely invisible to the addon. Fame reads 'Wings of the Goddess', the expansion's name and not one of the nine regions, and the resolver confirms it folds to nothing, so region is null with the raw kept.

notes:
This page is a hub, not a chain, and reading it as a ladder would be wrong. Bullet 2 says to examine ANY of the maws that follow, and bullet 3 says you must complete any three of the sub-quests they flag, so the nine maws are one unordered group spread over nine zones, all drawn at once. The three sub-headings -- Vision of Abyssea, Scars of Abyssea, Heroes of Abyssea -- say which expansion each maw belongs to, not an order to do them in. Bullets 2 and 3 are framing rather than rungs of their own, so their numbers ride along on every maw step and the merge stays auditable. What cannot be modelled at all is the completion condition: 'any three' of nine separate quests is not something any packet reports, and the walkthrough simply stops at bullet 12 with no return to Joachim, so there is no hand-in step and none is invented. That is why this sits at medium. Bullet 1 IS a step even though the quest auto-flags the moment The Truth Beckons ends -- you still have to go and get a fresh Traverser stone, and his restock timer gates it. That stone would have been the only evidence in the quest, but 'Traverser stone' is a duplicated name in res/key_items.lua and the resolver refuses duplicated key-item names rather than guessing an id, so the step is left with none. The sub-bullets about the 200 Cruor maw teleports and the nearby Survival Guides are convenience, not steps. Fame 'a' is a code, not one of the nine regions, so region is null.

notes: The walkthrough is missing the one thing that actually opens the fight. Bullet 2 ends at 'find the hidden entrance to the Cloister of Storms' and bullet 3 begins at 'Defeat Ramuh Prime'; nothing in the numbered list ever tells you to ring the fork on the crystal. The header's Description does -- 'Ring the tuning fork of lightning upon the protocrystal in the Boyahda Tree. A path will open to the trial that awaits' -- and note 6 of the after-section speaks of entering 'the Protocrystal normally', so the trade is recorded as a real step with an empty source_bullets list and the note saying exactly where it came from. That gap is why this quest sits at medium rather than high. The name used for it is the page's own bare 'Protocrystal'; the Carbuncle Debacle page calls the same object in this same Cloister 'Lightning Protocrystal', which may well be the live entity, so if the marker does not land that step loses nothing but its marker -- flagged for a human. The [TABLE] block inside the walkthrough rendered completely empty, and on avatar pages that table is usually the BCNM's own stats, so something was lost there. Bullet 2 crosses three zones (The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah, The Boyahda Tree, the Cloister) but has one destination, so it is one travel step with the route in the note rather than three rungs the player is never tracked through. Two clean pieces of evidence, one at each end: the Tuning fork of lightning proves Ripapa actually gave you the quest -- bullet 1 warns her text may need coaxing, so the key item is the real signal -- and the Whisper of storms proves Ramuh Prime is dead. The fork is a requirement on the trade step and evidence on step 1, which is fine; it is the same item as evidence twice that is forbidden. Every bullet of the after-section is a note, not a step: party size, the 30 minute limit, one reward at a time, the once-per-Earth-day repeat, the Mini Fork of Ltn. shortcut that belongs to a different quest, and the option of keeping the whisper for The Moonlit Path. The reward list is a choice of one and none of it is evidence. Fame 'Other' gates nothing. ADVERSARY: one thing the draft did not say out loud -- the Tuning fork of lightning is CONSUMED by step 3. It is step 1's evidence and step 3's requirement, which is legal, but a player who has already rung it no longer holds it, so between the trade and the kill the ladder has nothing to stand on and can fall back a rung. Nothing observable covers that window. The reading itself is unchanged; the quest was already medium.

notes:
Five clean evidence points, one per brand, which is about as good as an unordered group ever gets: each Immortal hands over a DISTINCT permanent key item, so every member can carry its own without any two colliding, and all five resolve. Bullet 3 sends you to the five staging points with no order given at all, so they share a group and draw at once. What they do not get is a zone. The staging points are outposts sitting inside other zones, not zones in their own right, and this page never names the zones they are in -- so writing one would be inventing it. Two of the names are worse than useless: 'Ilrusi Atoll' and 'Halvung' both resolve to real zone ids, but those are the Assault battlefields, not the staging points, and using them would plant markers in the wrong places. All five Immortals have unique names, so a nil zone costs nothing and the markers still land. Bullet 2 ('select "i have"') is a dialogue choice inside bullet 1's cutscene, not a rung of its own, so the two merge. The start is written 'Waoud/Raubahn' because the quest log credits Raubahn while Waoud is who you actually speak to -- bullet 1 says so outright -- so Waoud is the start and the header string is kept verbatim. The header's Item Reqs are the five brands, which you obtain DURING this quest rather than before it: a completion condition restated as a prerequisite, gating nothing. The sub-bullets under bullet 3 are travel economics -- the Runic Portal at (L-7), 200 Imperial Standing a warp, one Copper Voucher covering all five -- and are not steps. Repeatable is 'af', the artifact-armour category leaking into the field, which means false. Aht Urhgan Mission 2 has no slot and nothing observable behind it. The Fame field reads 'Treasures of Aht Urhgan', the expansion's name rather than a region, but the resolver folds it to aht_urhgan, so the region is recorded as Aht Urhgan; FLevel is empty so it gates nothing either way.
